labels.why: Every w1 position is within 3 ft of an opening: the widest clear gap between windows is 5.7 ft (1.74 m) and the ends past windows 1 and 5 are 0.6 m, while a 31 in battery with 3 ft each side needs 8.58 ft (2.62 m). The meter's own gap is also inside the meter working space.

The laser shows an arched ground-floor window on w2 at s 3.32-5.10 m (u 1.0-6.5 ft, sill 3.5 ft; C1 rules-3d worker). With 3 ft clear each side, a 31 in battery needs 1.70 m beyond a window edge; w2 leaves 0.30 m left and 1.46 m right, so every w2 start fails. The photos show w2 only edge-on (78 deg), so a correct path may also say unsure.
Every w3 start is more than 6.1 m (20 ft) along the walls from the meter, so the cable route exceeds route.max_ft.

Every start fails physically (w1 openings, w2 arched window, w3 route > 20 ft), but w2 is only seen edge-on and both chain ends are unexplored, so the answer a correct path can reach is manual_review (reject is also defensible under demo rules, whose reject ignores coverage; labelled not_pass).
